text:
Ana: Quick smoke test plan for inbound routing post-launch. Goal: verify 1) HS->SF handoff for MQL, 2) enrichment path, 3) round-robin fairness fix deployed. Proposed sample-rate: 20% for enrichment (to limit costs) and 100% for routing correctness. Canary in eu-west first. Thoughts? :rocket:
Mike: 20% enrichment sampling sounds reasonable. What's the SLA window we want to validate for claim acceptance + heartbeat?
Sophie: SLOs we should validate: heartbeat probe every 30s, acceptance window 2m for owner claim, enrichment debounce 45s, enrichment TTL 24h. Metrics to watch: inbound.handoff.latency_ms, enrichment.sampled_count, owner.claims.success_rate.
Jordan: For the RR bug patch let's do a feature-flag rollout: canary at 1% traffic -> 10% -> 100% with automated rollback if error_rate > 1% or claim-duplications > 0.1%. Also enable detailed logging for first 10k leads.
Ryan: I'll wire up a smoke-test script. Example webhook payload and quick curl to simulate HS: ```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.test/hs-webhook -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"test+1@acme.com","lead_source":"webinar","mql":true,"external_id":"ext-123"}'
``` Then assert: SF owner assigned, enrichment job queued (or sampled), and no duplicate owner claims.
devops-bot: Scheduled deploy: rr-fix-canary -> environment: staging -> eu-west; start_ts: 1739000300; status: pending :gear:
Ana: Also need to confirm webhook retries/backoff and idempotency key to avoid duplicates. @Sophie can you confirm debounce/dedupe window in middleware?
Sophie: Middleware uses header X-Redwood-Webhook-Id; dedupe window = 60s. For HS->SF mapping connector v2.3, ensure owner mapping falls back from owner_email -> owner_id. Logging includes lead.id and webhook_id. Enrichment sampler tags events with sampled=true so we can filter later.
Jordan: Add a short smoke checklist in a GH gist and trigger from CI. Steps: 1) send webhook 2) assert enrichment event queued (sampled or not) 3) assert owner assigned and not duplicated 4) confirm SF outbound webhook fired 5) check metrics: inbound.handoff.latency_ms p95 < 2000ms and owner.claims.success_rate > 99%.
Mike: I'll run manual tests after canary deploy and validate SF rows. Tagging @Sophie for signoff once we have logs.
Ana: Plan: start canary at 1739000300, run 1000 synthetic leads over 30m at 20% enrichment sampling. We'll collect sample logs and a histogram for latency and duplication counts. Report back in this thread. :white_check_mark:
devops-bot: Deploy started at 1739000305 :rocket:
Sophie: LGTM. I'll monitor dedupe and enrichment.sampled_count. Posting alert rule to PagerDuty if owner.claim.duplicates > 0.
Ryan: Running smoke tests now from ci-smoke runner (eu-west). Will post results in ~20m.
Mike: on it, watching SF changes and owner audit log.
Ana: Thanks everyone  unless anyone sees a blocker, proceed with the canary. We'll pause at the 10% ramp if any red flags. :eyes:
